sources.reading_verification: A full 428,509-byte PostScript copy of the authors' technical report was fetched and converted for inspection. The complete relevant passages were read. The review states the expected KL criterion and its Gaussian linear determinant specialization; the local proof supplies the extended joint-KL identity, negative-part justification, and singular-state extension rather than importing them from this source.

sources.locator: Complete 15-page paper; §2, full proof that expected entropy and cross-entropy information criteria agree; §3.1, equations (3.4)–(3.6), Gaussian determinant gain; §6.1 and Conclusion, model-correctness caveat.
sources.reading_verification: The complete 15-page PDF was fetched and inspected. The full §2 expectation argument, the complete §3.1 determinant derivation in the quadratic Gaussian setting, and the §6.1 wrong-model warning were read. MacKay's local-Gaussian approximation hypotheses are not silently extended to the exact general EIG identity or singular-prior theorem proved here.

contents.name: Expected entropy and cross-entropy information agree under the prior predictive law
contents.support: An independent expected-information derivation; the local proof gives the measure-theoretic density identity and controls the negative part explicitly.

contents.name: Gaussian quadratic-model information gain reduces to a log determinant
contents.support: Supports the Gaussian determinant criterion in the quadratic model. The local proof uses positive-definite conditional and predictive observation covariances and permits singular state covariance.

contents.name: Information gain can answer the wrong question under a misspecified model
contents.support: Supports the warning that a Bayesian information objective is conditional on its assumed model. The finite counterexample computes both the nominal positive EIG and the zero EIG for observationally identical truth/operator pairs.

sources.reading_verification: The complete book PDF was fetched. The complete relevant Chapter 2 Gaussian conditioning and Cholesky/log-marginal-likelihood passages were inspected, including Algorithm 2.1 and equation (2.30). contents.name: Cholesky solves and log determinant from the triangular factor
